chars.NEIGHBOUR: THE NEIGHBOUR: a Moroccan woman about 32, long dark wavy hair wrapped in a white towel turban, wearing a long plush pale-pink bathrobe tied at the waist and closed up to the neck, small gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: THE NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 23, short black fade haircut, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman about 50, wearing a burgundy house djellaba and a beige headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Seen from the stairs of a Casablanca apartment building, head-to-waist: THE NEIGHBOUR half-opens her front door, peeking out with a teasing surprised smile, one hand holding the door, the other at her towel turban, droplets on her face. Warm stairwell light, tiled landing. Subject centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. On the upper landing of a Casablanca apartment stairwell, THE NARRATOR knocks on a closed wooden door, leaning in and listening, puzzled because nobody answers. Head-to-waist framing from the side, subject centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. In a Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas, MOM stands with a shopping basket, pointing upward insistently with a stern smile while THE NARRATOR shrugs, annoyed. Both faces visible, centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Over THE NARRATOR's shoulder on the stairwell landing: the door swings open and THE NEIGHBOUR stands in the doorway fresh out of the shower, steam behind her, smiling warmly and waving him in. Her face clearly visible, centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical, comic. Close head-to-waist shot of THE NARRATOR frozen on the landing in front of an open door, mouth wide open, eyes huge, cheeks blushing red, hand stuck in mid-air. Subject centered, calm edges, no text.
